title: Jesus... Our Dog Died And I Told Work My Weekend Was Good
topic: his dog died on Tuesday and at work he told everyone his long weekend was good

bible.text: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... our dog died Tuesday. At work I said "weekend was good" and kept typing. 🐕

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You stopped at his bowl before leaving this morning.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It's just a dog. People lose so much more.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Grief isn't a contest. He was yours.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why do I feel silly crying?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Love that big leaves a big quiet. That's not silly.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Weeping may stay the night, but morning is not forgotten.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone who lost a pet and said nothing. Who's missing a good dog today? 👇
